name: Anti-Bloat – Disable WordPress Bloat & Notices
author: wp-zip

sections.description:
Anti-Bloat Plugin – Complete WordPress Admin Cleanup Solution

Anti-Bloat is a powerful and comprehensive plugin designed to clean up your WordPress admin interface by selectively removing bloat, notices, and unnecessary elements. Perfect for developers, agencies, and power users who want a clean, distraction-free admin experience.

🎯 Key Features

Notice Management:
* Hide admin notices and messages
* Remove WooCommerce notifications
* Disable plugin activation/update notices
* Control WordPress update notifications

Interface Cleanup:
* Remove default dashboard widgets
* Hide WordPress welcome panel
* Remove WordPress logo from admin bar
* Replace “Howdy” with “Welcome”
* Disable screen options and help tabs
* Remove WordPress version from source

Performance Optimization:
* Performance mode for faster admin
* Disable WordPress heartbeat on non-post pages
* Remove unnecessary dashboard elements
* Optimize admin resource loading

Security Enhancements:
* Hide WordPress version information
* Disable file editing in admin
* Remove version from CSS/JS files
* Enhanced security headers

🚀 New in Version 1.1.0

  • Granular Controls: Choose exactly what to hide instead of all-or-nothing
  • Tabbed Interface: Organized settings with General, Notices, Interface, Performance, and Info tabs
  • WordPress 6.8.3 Compatible: Fully tested with the latest WordPress version
  • WooCommerce 10.8.4 Compatible: Full support for the latest WooCommerce
  • Performance Mode: Advanced optimizations for faster admin experience
  • Better UI: Modern, responsive settings interface with real-time preview
  • Export/Import: Save and restore your configurations
  • Developer Mode: Additional debugging and development features
  • Multisite Support: Works perfectly with WordPress multisite networks
  • Complete Uninstall: Properly cleans up all data when removed

👨‍💻 Perfect For:

  • Developers – Clean interface without distracting notices
  • Agencies – Professional client dashboards
  • Site Managers – Streamlined admin experience
  • Performance Enthusiasts – Faster admin loading times

🛡️ Safe & Secure

  • No data collection or tracking
  • Minimal resource footprint
  • Complete data cleanup on uninstall
  • Follows WordPress coding standards
  • Regular security updates

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Plugin Homepage
* Support Forum
* Documentation

Privacy

Anti-Bloat does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All settings are stored locally in your WordPress database.

Contributing

Anti-Bloat is open source! Contribute on GitHub or translate the plugin on WordPress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/anti-bloat/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Anti-Bloat’ in your admin menu to configure settings
  4. Choose your preferred cleanup options
  5. Save settings and enjoy your clean admin interface
sections.faq:
Is this plugin safe to use?

Yes! Anti-Bloat only hides interface elements and doesn’t modify your database or core files. All changes are reversible by deactivating the plugin.

Will this affect my website’s frontend?

No, Anti-Bloat only affects the WordPress admin area. Your website visitors won’t see any changes.

Can I choose specific features to enable?

Absolutely! Version 1.1.0 introduces granular controls. You can enable/disable individual features as needed.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Anti-Bloat has specific features for hiding WooCommerce admin notices and is fully compatible with WooCommerce 10.8.4.

Will this break my admin?

No, Anti-Bloat is designed to be safe. If you experience any issues, simply deactivate the plugin to restore everything.

Does it work with multisite?

Yes! Anti-Bloat works perfectly with WordPress multisite installations and includes proper cleanup for network sites.

Can I export my settings?

Yes! The new version includes export/import functionality to save and restore your configurations.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Anti-Bloat is designed to work alongside other plugins. It uses WordPress standards and hooks to ensure compatibility.
